title: Hallon

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hallon is a character found in Meadows. It is a tamed Lox that accompanies Hildir at her trading camp.

sections.heading: Biography
sections.text: Nothing is known about Hallon beyond the fact it is a Lox that resides with Hildir in her camp feeding from a bowl alongside Blåbär.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• "Hallon" is swedish word, meaning raspberry. It is derived from hall "cliff" and -on (suffix for fruits and berries).
• Hallon and Blåbär can be pet.
